atoms.text: Mimi still hasn’t found any treasure. Will you help her search the Indian Ocean?

instruction.text: The Indian Ocean is the third biggest ocean on Earth. Can you point it out to Mimi on the map?

atoms.a: “I want to stop off at some land. Which continent can I stay at?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f10'>I want to stop off at some land. Which continent can I stay at?</voice>

atoms.a: “I was told to bring bottled water. Do you know why I can’t drink the seawater?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f10'>I was told to bring bottled water. Do you know why I can’t drink the seawater?</voice>

feedback.end: Most of the water on Earth is salt water. Be careful not to swallow it when you go to the beach!

instruction.text: Mimi goes for a swim in the warm Indian Ocean. Find the shark in this image to tell her a fun fact.

feedback.end: Earth’s oceans are home to over 240,000 known animal species, and there’s still many more to discover!

instruction.text: Can you remember where the Indian Ocean is on the map? Drag the label to the correct place on the image.

hint.text: This ocean gets its name from being south of India, which is a country in Asia.
